note: Real repositories, cloned shallow, measured, and deleted again. The fixture corpus cannot see a pattern that no fixture happens to write: `destination:\s*\w` went in at 1.27.0 with 0 changes across 234 fixtures and inferred three B2B products as marketplaces, because no fixture writes a Next.js redirect. These are the counterweight. Sources are deleted after each run. Language coverage matters as much as product coverage: the detectors carry rules for Go, Rust, PHP, Ruby and .NET that no JavaScript or Python repository can exercise, and every one of those rules was written for a real repository that is named in the comment beside it. Those repositories are here so the rule stays measured.
